_schema._comment: Fill 'checks' with manual ground-truth checks. Entries with "example": true are skipped by seed_verified_checks.py. Validation lives in api/_lib/verified_checks.py (validate_check).
_schema.route: string, AAA-AAA (uppercase IATA codes), e.g. the origin and destination airports joined by a hyphen
_schema.check_date: ISO date YYYY-MM-DD, the day you looked at the official site
_schema.flight_date: ISO date YYYY-MM-DD, the departure date that was checked
_schema.carrier_checked: airline NAME as shown on result cards (the display carrier), not an IATA code
_schema.sandbox_price_jpy: positive integer (JPY, the tool price converted at the fixed rate); null or 0 allowed only for 'not_comparable'
_schema.real_price_jpy: positive integer (JPY, the official-site price); null or 0 allowed only for 'not_comparable'
_schema.verdict: 'match' = abs(sandbox - real) / real <= 5%; 'mismatch' = difference above 5%; 'not_comparable' = the itinerary could not be matched on the official site (its notes must not imply a verdict)

checks.notes: PLACEHOLDER ONLY: format example, not real data. The seed script skips entries with example=true.
